Nobody understood the internet, everyone just saw it as the "new big media" that was like a wild west gold-rush of opportunity and I guarantee a lot of these guys were young techies who could talk enough of the talk to just scam people out of millions -- which is pretty much what they did as most of the ideas being pitched back then just wouldn't ever have worked with the technology available at the time.
